title: Files & Editor
subtitle: Edit any repository on GitHub — change, add, move and delete files, then save it all as one commit.
startBody: Browse and edit its files right here. Nothing goes to GitHub until you save — then everything becomes one commit.
truncated: Very large repo: GitHub listed only part of the files.

keys.stage: Keep the edit (it's staged as you type)

tree.folderHint: Click a folder to choose where new files and uploads go

path.label: Path in the repository
path.exists: A file with this path exists

editor.pickBody: Pick a file on the left, or create a new one.
editor.deleted: This file is staged for deletion.
editor.notThere: The file didn't exist at that point

changes.noneBody: Edits, new files, moves and deletions show up here.
changes.oneCommit: Everything is saved as one commit. If someone else saved to this branch meanwhile, nothing is overwritten — you'll be told.

folder.intoSub: Put it in its own folder
folder.big: That's a lot to send in one go — it works, but takes a while. Big binaries are better as release files.
